req.title: Redirect count boundary
req.statement: The system shall accept /redirect/<n> with n in the range 1..30 inclusive and reject values above.

doc.reasoning: The violation is test[2]: kind=negative but heuristic=BVA. BVA is reserved for boundary tests (kind=boundary). n=31 is the first value above the upper boundary, which is a boundary-adjacent negative case. To fix: change kind to 'boundary' (since n=31 is the upper+1 BVA point, which is a standard BVA boundary test) — this is the correct fix because BVA explicitly includes the point just outside the boundary. All other tests are preserved unchanged.

tests.name: test_redirect_n1_lower_boundary_returns_302_to_get
preconditions: n=1 is the lower boundary of the valid range
trace: R-HTTPBIN-048: n=1 is the minimum valid value; BVA lower bound
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()
r = client.get('/redirect/1', follow_redirects=False)
assert r.status_code == 302
location = r.headers.get('Location', '')
assert '/get' in location

preconditions: n=0 is below the minimum valid value of 1
expected: HTTP 500 response (assert n > 0 fires) or HTTP 4xx

tests.name: test_redirect_n1_follows_to_get_endpoint
expected: Response JSON contains 'url' key from /get handler
trace: R-HTTPBIN-048: n=1 final destination is /get; EP positive; verifies end-to-end redirect resolution
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
import json
client = app.test_client()
r = client.get('/redirect/1', follow_redirects=True)
assert r.status_code == 200
data = json.loads(r.data)
assert 'url' in data
assert 'headers' in data

tests.name: test_redirect_n32_well_above_upper_boundary_rejected
preconditions: n=32 is well above the maximum valid value of 30
expected: HTTP 404 response (value above valid range is rejected)
trace: R-HTTPBIN-048: n=32 is in the invalid partition above 30; NEG + EP invalid partition; confirms rejection is not a one-off
tests.executable:

client = app.test_client()
r = client.get('/redirect/32', follow_redirects=False)
assert r.status_code == 404
assert r.status_code != 302
assert r.status_code != 200

tests.name: test_redirect_n2_decrements_location_correctly
trace: R-HTTPBIN-048: DT decision: n>1 uses _redirect helper; verifies n-1 decrement arithmetic; catches n->n+1 or n->n-1 mutations in redirect chain
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()
r = client.get('/redirect/2', follow_redirects=False)
assert r.status_code == 302
location = r.headers.get('Location', '')
assert '/redirect/1' in location
assert '/redirect/2' not in location
